### 3.3 Non-Functional Requirements {#3.3-non-functional-requirements}

##### **Performance** {#performance}

---

*3.3.1.1 Classification Accuracy*

* *The system shall achieve a classification accuracy of at least 85% on the held-out test set of the PhilRice ASV image dataset, measured as the proportion of correctly classified images across all seven ASV score categories.*  
* *The system shall achieve a macro-average F1-score of at least 80% across all seven ASV score categories on the held-out test set.*  
* *The system shall achieve a Cohen's kappa coefficient of at least 0.75 when the deployed model's predictions are compared against ASV scores assigned by certified PhilRice evaluators on the Phase 4 evaluation dataset, indicating substantial inter-rater agreement.*  
* *The system shall report per-class F1-scores individually for ASV score categories 3, 4, and 5 in the model evaluation report, as these categories represent the highest classification difficulty due to visual ambiguity between adjacent scores.*


*3.3.1.2 Inference Latency*

* *The system shall complete the full image preprocessing, CNN inference, temperature scaling calibration, and results display pipeline within an average latency of 10 seconds per submitted image, measured across a minimum of 20 test cases on the target Android device.*  
* *The system shall complete image quality validation within 3 seconds of image submission.*  
* *The system shall generate the batch summary report within 10 seconds of session closure.*  
* *The system shall generate the CSV export file within 5 seconds of the user's export request.*


*3.3.1.3 Usability Performance*

* *The system shall achieve a mean System Usability Scale (SUS) score of at least 70 (target: at least 80\) among rice breeders and agronomists at PhilRice during structured user acceptance testing conducted under laboratory and simulated field conditions*

*3.3.1.4 UI Responsiveness*

* *The system shall render all screen transitions and navigation actions within 500 milliseconds of user interaction under normal operating conditions, ensuring the interface does not appear to freeze or become unresponsive during non-inference operations.*  
* *The system shall display inline validation feedback on all metadata input form fields within 200 milliseconds of the user completing each field, without requiring the user to submit the form to discover validation errors.*  
* *The system shall display a loading indicator or progress feedback to the user within 1 second of initiating any operation with an expected completion time greater than 2 seconds, including CNN inference, explainability computation, report generation, and CSV export.*

*3.3.1.5 Efficiency Against Manual Baseline*

* *The system shall demonstrate a per-batch evaluation time that is at least 50% shorter than the documented manual ASV scoring baseline when both are measured under equivalent conditions during Phase 4 comparative testing, confirming that AlkaSense meaningfully reduces the time burden of ASV evaluation at PhilRice.*

##### **Security** {#security}

---

The security requirements for AlkaSense focus on protecting the integrity of the Alkali Spreading Value (ASV) data and ensuring that only authorized PhilRice evaluators can modify AI-generated results.

* **Authentication and Authorization**:  
  * The system shall utilize Firebase Authentication to restrict access to the application.  
  * The system shall implement Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) to ensure that only "Certified Evaluators" can access the Manual Score Override (Module 5\) and the Correction Log.  
* **Data Integrity:**  
  * The system shall utilize Checksum/Hash validation for the TFLite model binary upon application startup to ensure the AI model has not been tampered with or corrupted.  
  * Critical variables, specifically the ASV-to-GT lookup table, shall be hardcoded as final/immutable constants to prevent runtime modification.  
* **Communication Security:**  
  * All data synchronization with the PhilRice Central Data Server shall be performed exclusively over HTTPS (TLS 1.2 or higher).  
  * The system shall utilize certificate pinning to prevent man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks during data export or synchronization.  
* **Logging and Audit Trails:**  
  * The system shall maintain an on-device audit log that records every manual score correction, including the Evaluator ID, original score, corrected score, and the ISO 8601 timestamp.  
  * The system shall log all failed login attempts and unauthorized attempts to access the "Expert-Verified" modules.  
* **Cryptography**:  
  * Locally stored sensitive metadata (such as evaluator credentials or API keys) shall be encrypted using the Android Keystore System (AES-256 encryption)

##### 

##### **Reliability** {#reliability}

---

Reliability requirements specify the system's ability to maintain functional consistency across various Android hardware environments and intermittent connectivity.

* **Availability and Robustness:**  
  * The system shall be designed as an **Offline-First application**, ensuring that 100% of core functions (Image Acquisition, AI Inference, and Result Storage) are available without an active internet connection.  
  * The system shall achieve a **99% successful execution rate** for the on-device inference pipeline under standard operating conditions (supported Android API levels).  
* **Error Recovery (Fault Tolerance):**  
  * The system shall utilize **transactional database operations** (via Room/SQLite) to ensure that if the app crashes during a session, no previously saved result records are corrupted or lost.  
  * In the event of a network failure during synchronization with the PhilRice server, the system shall implement an **exponential backoff retry mechanism** once connectivity is restored.  
* **Validation Gate (Reliable Input):**  
  * The system shall implement an **Image Quality Validation Gate** (as specified in FR-M2-12 through FR-M2-15) to prevent unreliable or blurry images from being processed by the CNN, thereby maintaining the reliability of the output scores.  
* **Model Consistency:**  
  * The system shall produce **deterministic outputs**; given the same input image and model version, the system must return an identical ASV score every time.  
* **Data Persistence:**  
  * The system shall ensure that **100% of archived feedback records** (Module 5.2) are relationally linked to their raw images, preventing "orphaned" data points that would hinder future model retraining.
